status: Implemented candidate, technical checks passed; live visual/performance acceptance pending
changes: Face irradiance retains 65% vanilla weights with 35% realistic world-space light at full skylight; cave/exposure gating and existing strength/blend controls remain.
Default sun samples the current Minecraft 1.21.11 square texture with HDR warmth and existing haze; round procedural core/aureole removed. Native vanilla sun/moon mode remains.
Atmosphere resolve evaluates rejected-depth pixels at exact full-resolution depth using the selected full atmosphere budget, with smooth confidence blending instead of zero fog.

native.scope: Native macOS OpenGL compatibility shims, not live Iris loading

gpu.scope: Actual expanded GLSL on native OpenGL, including baseline/reference comparisons; not Minecraft visual acceptance

performance.quality_preservation: No resolution, sample, draw-distance, preset or control reduction. Full selected atmosphere quality in selective fallback, no extra pass. Live equivalence and frame cost pending.
performance.risk: Thin geometry with poor reduced-resolution depth coverage can invoke additional full-quality atmosphere integration; requires matched forest scenes and focused frame-time measurement.

live.limitation: Native desktop inventory cannot select the running Minecraft Java window. Existing game remains open; no competing world session.

limits: The depth-miss black-dot mechanism is reproduced and fixed in a controlled GPU test; other foliage/mipmap/driver causes cannot be excluded without the actual scene.
Sun texture uses the 1.21.11 environment/celestial/sun.png resource path; resource-pack replacements can change its appearance. No Mojang texture is redistributed.
The polished sun projection is custom sky rendering, not the native celestial draw; option 1 retains the native renderer.
Existing 1.6.5 cloud range, small-cell horizon aliasing risks and screen-space water limitations remain.
